text:
ana: quick idea — add a compact legend affordance to the heatmap that shows data-quality state (Exact / Aggregated / Sampled) and a tiny inline toggle to turn sampling previews on/off. keeps the chart clean but makes provenance obvious

mike: yes. two asks: 1) make the toggle keyboard-focusable and 2) provide a short tooltip that says \"Sampling shows estimates from N samples\" not just \"sampled\" :keyboard: 

sara: accessibility: colors alone aren't enough. include icons + accessible name, e.g. `aria-label=\"Data quality: sampled (n=24)\"`. tooltip text should be exposed to `aria-describedby` and announced when state changes (aria-live polite)

lex: micro-interaction: when user mouses over the legend state (or focuses it) show a mini-preview that overlays up to 3 bucket sparklines and an estimated delta badge. debounce hover at 250ms so it feels snappy but doesn't hammer infra

kevin: infra note: keep previews client-side and cap requests to 3 buckets. add feature flag `legend_sample_preview` and telemetry events: `legend_toggled`, `legend_preview_opened`

jamie: copy nits: label the toggle \"Sampling previews\" and for the legend entries use short labels: \"Exact\", \"Agg.\", \"Est. (sampled)\". also prefer full phrase in tooltip: \"Estimated p95 based on N samples\"

ana: tiny correction, should be \"ana\" above :) UX question: should the legend adhere to user timezone for the preview timestamps? I think yes, but add a small timezone badge in the preview header

mike: agree to local timezone in previews, default UTC everywhere else. show `TZ: UTC` in the legend overflow menu so users can switch quickly

sara: color ramp reminder: avoid ramps that fail deuteranopia tests. recommend blue->amber with numeric ticks and an alternate high-contrast mode that forces icons + outlines

lex: behavior detail: if user pins a preview (keyboard `p`), create a small chip in the pinned area with time + state and allow comparisons. pins should be per-tab and keyboard-navigable

kevin: rollout: gradual behind `legend_sample_preview` FF. collect `legend_seen`, `legend_toggled`, `preview_pinned`. keep preview payload tiny: {samples: [t1,t2,t3], estDelta}
dev-bot: preview build: https://staging-console.redwood-inference.com/legend-preview (expires 72h) :rocket:

ana: I'll update Figma and add acceptance checklist: 1) keyboard focus + tooltip docs, 2) aria-live for legend changes, 3) debounce + cap for previews, 4) color + icon affordance for a11y, 5) feature flag + telemetry. will post mocks by EOD :thumbsup:
